ops.title: heads-up: accountterminal calls proc.Reaper.TerminateWithin at 3 sites — API now unused inside daemonkit itself
ops.description: Found during the daemonkit v0.20.6 settlement-fix sweep (2026-07-25): internal/accountterminal/terminal.go calls proc.Reaper.TerminateWithin at :516, :1190, :1201. These settle via the synchronous Reaper/Untrack path, so they are UNAFFECTED by the v0.20.6 deferred-untrack contract change — no bug, no urgency. But daemonkit itself no longer uses TerminateWithin internally after the settlement rework, making cc-pool the surviving consumer of a possibly-legacy API surface. Sentinel/API identity is load-bearing fleet-wide, so daemonkit will not remove it silently — this task is the coordination point: either bless it as supported public API or migrate these sites when convenient.

ops.text: decide: keep TerminateWithin as supported public API (document it) or migrate the 3 accountterminal sites to the settlement-path successor
